sources.entry: Phosphene - Use any video as your macOS wallpaper on the desktop and the lock screen, picked directly from System Settings.

summary.one_liner: Phosphene is a macOS app that adds your own videos to System Settings' wallpaper picker so they play on the desktop and lock screen, and can convert Steam Workshop Wallpaper Engine wallpapers into looping video wallpapers.
summary.what_it_does: The app imports videos through a Library window and registers them with the same wallpaper pipeline Apple uses for its Aerials, so they appear in System Settings → Wallpaper. Playback continues on the desktop and lock screen after Phosphene is quit. It supports per-display or per-Space selection, a lock-screen-only mode, and MP4, MOV and other AVFoundation-readable formats with gapless looping. Playback pauses under covered desktops and adjusts decoding for power and thermal conditions. For Wallpaper Engine wallpapers downloaded through Steam Workshop (via Sevoflurane, CrossOver or Whisky), it makes looping video versions. The menu bar offers preview, pause, display switching, launch at login, and a Restart Wallpaper Agent command. The README also describes an opt-in anonymous usage count, which is off unless the user chooses it.
use_cases: set a personal video as macOS wallpaper
use Steam Workshop Wallpaper Engine wallpapers on a Mac
convert animated wallpapers to looping video
per-display video wallpaper in System Settings
keep video wallpaper running after closing the app
notable: Registers personal videos into System Settings → Wallpaper alongside Apple's Aerials
Converts Steam Workshop Wallpaper Engine wallpapers into looping videos
Playback persists on desktop and lock screen after the app quits
Power- and thermal-aware playback with optional lower-resolution variants
Opt-in anonymous check-in; off unless the user enables it
caveats: Relies on private WallpaperExtensionKit APIs that macOS updates can break
Wallpaper Engine conversion needs Steam running via Sevoflurane, CrossOver or Whisky on the Mac
